[[File:Ogre chathead.png|left|80px]]
'''Ogres''' are monsters found in several locations, most notably the ogre city of [[Gu'Tanoth]] and [[Feldip Hills]]. The caged level 56 ogres at the [[Combat Training Camp]] near [[Ardougne]] (which can be entered after finishing the [[Biohazard]] quest) can only be attacked with Ranged, Magic, or [[halberd]]s. Attempting to use a non-halberd melee weapon will render the message: {{RSFont|These ogres are for ranged combat only.|color=red}} The cage can be entered through a loose railing at the side, though can still only be fought with ranged inside as well. Additionally, halberds do not work while inside the cage.

A [[dwarf multicannon]] may be used to kill ogres west of Yanille.

On [[17 March]] [[2009]], the graphics of ogres were updated to match those of [[Ogress]]es.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (11 January 2010)|date=11 January 2010}}

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (9 November 2009)|date=9 November 2009}}

==Trivia==
* It appears that when ogres exhale, their stomachs flap up and down.
* The ogres and ogresses are possible references to the {{WP|Gargareans}} and the {{WP|Amazons}} due to the ogres being an all-male tribe, and the ogresses an all-female tribe.
* Ogres are able to shoot extremely far with their giant bows, as far as from the Feldip Hills to Karamja over sea.
